binary_search.title: Binary Search
binary_search.description: A divide-and-conquer algorithm that finds the position of a target value within a sorted array.

strengths: Does not require extra memory space
weaknesses: The dataset MUST be completely sorted first

languages.python:
def binary_search(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left <= right:
        mid = left + (right - left) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target: return mid
        elif arr[mid] < target: left = mid + 1
        else: right = mid - 1
    return -1

two_pointers.title: Two Pointers Technique
two_pointers.description: An algorithmic pattern using two indices to iterate through a data structure simultaneously.

use_cases: Finding pairs that sum to a target in a sorted array
Reversing an array or string in-place
strengths: Drastically reduces nested loop runtime complexity from O(n^2) to O(n)
weaknesses: Usually requires the underlying array data to be pre-sorted

languages.python:
def has_target_pair(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        current_sum = arr[left] + arr[right]
        if current_sum == target: return True
        elif current_sum < target: left += 1
        else: right -= 1
    return False
